title: Reefer Cargo Services: what counts as a temperature excursion and how it is logged
content:
## Scope

This definition card of **Reefer Cargo Services** states when the carrying temperature of a reefer is in excursion, how long an excursion is taken to last, and how it is logged on the service.

## Rule

1. An excursion is a period in which the **return-air temperature** stays outside the band formed by the set point plus or minus the tier's temperature tolerance.
2. Its length is measured in **whole logging intervals** of the unit's temperature recorder.
3. The unit's recorder logs the excursion and the line records it on the service, **whatever its cause**.
4. The excursion record shows the date the excursion started, the port (or the vessel's last port), the continuous minutes outside tolerance and the peak deviation temperature. It carries no charge (0.00 USD).

## Tolerance and logging interval by tier

| Tier | Tolerance around the set point | Recorder logging interval |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 2.0 °C | 60 minutes |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 1.5 °C | 15 minutes |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 0.5 °C | 15 minutes |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 1.0 °C | 15 minutes |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 1.0 °C | 5 minutes |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 3.0 °C | 15 minutes |

## Worked band examples (hypothetical set points)

> **AHL Reefer Pharma GDP at a set point of 5.0 °C.** The band runs from 5.0 °C less 1.0 °C to 5.0 °C plus 1.0 °C, that is, from 4.0 °C to 6.0 °C. Return air at 6.4 °C is outside the band; return air at 5.8 °C is inside it.

> **AHL Reefer Cold Treatment at a set point of 0.5 °C.** The band runs from 0.0 °C to 1.0 °C. Return air at 1.3 °C is outside the band.

> **AHL Reefer Superfreezer at a set point of -60.0 °C.** The band runs from -63.0 °C to -57.0 °C. Return air at -55.0 °C is outside the band.

## Measuring the length

The excursion minutes are always a whole number of the tier's logging intervals.

> Hypothetical: on AHL Reefer Pharma GDP the recorder shows return air outside the band for 12 consecutive five-minute intervals. The excursion is recorded as 60 continuous minutes. On AHL Reefer Standard, whose interval is 60 minutes, excursion minutes are always a multiple of 60.

## Basis Q&A

**The shipper caused the excursion by an instruction of its own. Is it still recorded?** Yes. An excursion is recorded whatever its cause.

**Does recording an excursion credit the customer or charge anything?** The excursion record itself carries no amount; it is a log entry on the service.

**Is supply-air temperature used to judge an excursion?** The rule judges an excursion on return-air temperature.
